mapper.select: SELECT ad.id, ad.name, ad.bus_no, ad.py_str, ad.wb_str, ad.category_code, ad.type_code, ad.purchase_unit_code, ad.total_volume, ad.item_min_quantity, ad.item_max_quantity, ad.split_unit_code, ad.merchandise_name, ad.merchandise_py_str, ad.merchandise_wb_str, ad.def_encounter_unit_code, ad.def_inhospital_unit_code, ad.org_id, ad.location_id, ad.model_number, ad.hvcm_flag, ad.dose_unit_code, ad.package_unit_code, ad.stock_unit_code, ad.approval_number, ad.manufacturer_id, ad.manufacturer_text, ad.supply_id, ad.description, ad.jurisdiction, ad.device_version, ad.substance_text, ad.allergen_flag, ad.rx_flag, ad.yb_flag, ad.yb_no, ad.yb_org_no, ad.yb_match_flag, ad.chrgitm_lv, ad.status_enum, ad.active_flag, ad.yb_mapping_code, ad.dose_unit_ratio, ad.purchase_unit_ratio, ad.stock_unit_ratio, ad.package_unit_ratio, ac.price_type_code, ac.price_value FROM adm_device_definition ad INNER JOIN adm_charge_item_definition ac ON ad.id = ac.instance_id WHERE ad.id = #{equipmentId} AND ad.is_deleted = 0
